According to the course material, how many types of circuits in an ATM network are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two types of circuits in an ATM network:  Permanent Virtual Circuit (PVC): A circuit that is set up once in the switches to allow communication between two devices  Switched Virtual Circuit (SVC): A circuit that is temporarily set up just for the duration of a communication two devices.
